en.title: Accessibility Setbacks and Advances: Beach Mat Removed, Gaming Gains
en.summary: The Department of Natural Resources removed an accessibility mat from Heather Beach after vandalism, reducing beach access for people with disabilities. Meanwhile, Marvel's Wolverine launches with over 100 accessibility options, and Harvard researchers released a smartphone navigation app for blind and low vision users. Be My Eyes partnered with Tracfone for 24/7 accessible support, while Evanston's dog beach ramp plan faces cost challenges.

highlights.title: DNR removes accessibility mat from Heather Beach after repeated vandalism - Yahoo News Canada
Marvel's Wolverine Launches Sept 15 With 100-Plus Accessibility Options and Day-One NG+
Smartphone Navigation App for Blind and Low Vision
Be My Eyes and Tracfone Partnership
Evanston’s plans to make dog beach accessible hounded by rising costs for ramp

zh-TW.title: 海灘無障礙設施受阻，遊戲與導航App提升 accessibility
zh-TW.summary: 由於屢遭破壞，DNR 移除了 Heather Beach 的無障礙墊，影響殘障人士的海灘使用。Marvel《金鋼狼》將於9月15日推出超過100項無障礙功能，哈佛團隊開發盲人導航App。此外，日本的融合教育面臨實施挑戰，埃文斯頓狗海灘坡道計畫則因經費上升受阻。

highlights.title: DNR 因屢遭破壞移除 Heather Beach 無障礙墊 - Yahoo News Canada
Marvel《金鋼狼》將於9月15日推出，提供超過100項無障礙選項及當日NG+模式
針對盲人與低視力者的智慧型手機導航應用程式
埃文斯頓計畫建造坡道以使狗海灘無障礙，但經費上升造成阻礙
